name: aisafe
description: Audit the prompts and algorithms of AI-enabled software for profiling, manipulation, engineered emotional attachment, deceptive identity and behavioural influence over the person using it (aisafe audit); walk each finding by mechanism, record a named person's review bound to the prompts they read (aisafe review), remediate one approval at a time, and evaluate the running system with fixed scenarios (aisafe evaluate). Deterministic and offline. Findings carry evidence and a policy decision, never a certification.
